_comment: Independent muse.c rnd_defensive_item() witness for Pestilence: wizard genesis creates a counted group of Pestilence, then #wizmakemap removes them. C's case 5 returns POT_SICKNESS for Pestilence, which merges with the POT_SICKNESS that makemon() gives every Pestilence, so mdrop_special_objs() draws one obj_resists() per stack. The seed, clock, role, and name are chosen independently.
